AZSX-29.scope_note: Portable rule and selected-adapter fixtures cover solo/host/guest and all five actor slots. Windows runtime scope tests cover reentrancy and unwind cleanup. These are not live spell-radius evidence. Lua 5.1 covers informational-aura lifecycle, detached API, tooltip notes, first placement, ownership and native fallback. Visual placement still requires rendered review.

AZSX-30.scope_note: Portable route, group-presence, identity, reward and large-footprint interior-clearance policy; exact 0.138.0 native byte/field review; Lua 5.1 variable-route schema and Windows ABI checks. Scene movement, native participant effects and extraction rewards require artifact-scoped live solo and two-client coop trials.

targeted_scenario.trigger: In isolated 0.138.0 solo and two-client coop runs, approach one native Mechanical Chicken, test one participant leaving and returning, then reach its Goblin Teleporter.
targeted_scenario.expected: At most one escort per run; native chicken, teleporter and scenery appear for both clients; progress pauses if any active participant is absent or downed and resumes without reset; extraction removes the scene and grants one individual gadget to each current participant exactly once. Variable route totals retain the whole AZSX UI state; start and extraction footprints reject blocked interior native navigation cells.
targeted_scenario.limit: A bounded trial may not exercise all six random gadgets or observe a full normal post-boss route; report these separately from portable and diagnostic evidence. Purely visual tree models absent from native navigation require separate scenery evidence.
